scope: Current local Quarkus tree, including pre-existing uncommitted recovery changes

phases.title: Multilingual Input Foundation
phases.findings: Immutable original input, language/locale/source metadata and backwards-compatible API request constructors. Tests cover supported-language samples; this does not certify model quality.

phases.title: Language Detection and Normalization
phases.findings: Ordered Unicode, URL, HTML, whitespace and control-character rules with trace. LanguageServiceTest covers 11 realistic language samples. Short Latin input intentionally falls back to English; declared language is currently trusted as a hint.

phases.title: Translation and Mixed-Language Understanding
phases.findings: AI rewrites and an explicit original-query fallback for empty model rewrite lists exist. No translation/equivalence contract or multilingual constraint-preservation acceptance gate.

phases.title: Intent Detection
phases.findings: Intent enum, confidence, parser and UNKNOWN fallback exist. An interactive ambiguity/disambiguation protocol and measured multilingual intent quality are absent.

phases.title: Entity and Constraint Extraction
phases.findings: Grounded entity spans and English under/below/up-to prices in USD/EUR/SEK. No general date, time, place, range, multilingual amount or negation extraction. The public AI analysis maps entities to UNKNOWN.

phases.title: Typed Intermediate Representation
phases.findings: Immutable version-1 IR validates entity evidence spans and rejects other versions. Covers the existing entity/price vocabulary; not a full commerce schema and not attached to the public pipeline.

phases.title: Schema Registry
phases.findings: Static allowlist for price, BRAND and PRODUCT. No schema registration/update API, schema version lifecycle or backend mapping registry.

phases.title: Constraint Validation and Mapping
phases.findings: Logical allowlists, duplicates, evidence and resource budgets exist in the opt-in structured path. The public API does not run this path. Normal OpenSearch compilation now rejects nonempty uncompiled constraints rather than dropping them.

phases.title: Security Input Validation
phases.findings: Deterministic injection/payload detectors, YAML rules, correlation and pipeline stop-before-AI behavior have unit/API coverage. Rule coverage is not proof against every novel payload.

phases.title: AI Threat Detection
phases.findings: Hybrid in test names means combined rule/correlation detectors. No AI threat-classifier invocation or model/rule arbitration contract is implemented.

phases.title: Policy and Authorization Engine
phases.findings: Policy checks rewrite content and breadth before execution. X-API-Key is used for rate limiting, not authentication. No principal/tenant identity, roles, resource permissions or identity-based authorization.

phases.title: Explainability and Confidence Model
phases.findings: Conservative minimum of intent/semantic/decision signals; absent analysis scores zero. API and SDKs expose uncalibrated confidenceAssessment. Rule-based blocks identify their method. No calibrated probability model or general evidence graph.

phases.title: Filterless Commerce Core
phases.findings: Natural-language retrieval works, but public DecisionStep executes ordinary SearchRequest without QueryIR/constraint compilation. Price language in a query is not an enforced filter.

phases.title: Product Catalog Intelligence
phases.findings: Only the demo seed index and generic document maps exist. No product ingestion/normalization service, catalog schema, product relations or catalog-quality tests.

phases.title: Query-to-Filter Compilation
phases.findings: Opt-in OpenSearch keyword price/currency filters exist. Structured vector/hybrid and other backends are rejected or absent; no cross-backend typed filter acceptance suite.

phases.title: Keyword, Vector and Hybrid Search
phases.findings: OpenSearch keyword, kNN and bool-should hybrid retrieval plus embedding provider exist. The live test is opt-in and needs BGE-M3 and seeded products. Hybrid is combined scoring, not an independently tuned fusion model.

phases.title: Ranking and Reranking
phases.findings: Ranking no longer clips all raw scores above one into a tie. QueryTermReranker provides a replaceable deterministic baseline when requested; disabled mode retains NoOpReranker. No learned/cross-encoder model or validated uplift benchmark.

phases.title: Query Relaxation and Zero-Result Recovery
phases.findings: No zero-hit trigger, relaxation planner, preserved hard-constraint policy or recovery acceptance tests.

phases.title: Search Suggestions and Refinement
phases.findings: AI rewrites exist. There is no suggestion/refinement API, candidate ranking or iterative user refinement state.

phases.title: Search Session and Conversation Context
phases.findings: StreamingSessionRegistry tracks SSE subscriptions, not conversation memory. No persisted turns, carried constraints, session isolation or context-expiry contract.

phases.title: Commerce Domain Pack
phases.findings: No installable commerce pack, pack manifest or commerce domain model/contract.

phases.title: Commerce Provider Connectors
phases.findings: Generic provider SPI/registry/resolver exist. They are not a catalog synchronization/ingestion connector SPI. Shopify is not present in source, tests or inspected Git history.

phases.title: Elasticsearch Connector
phases.findings: No Elasticsearch client, credential configuration, connector, mappings or compatibility tests. OpenSearch implementation is not evidence of Elasticsearch support.

phases.title: OpenSearch Connector
phases.findings: Queries, mappings, response adaptation, retry/error behavior and timeouts exist. The local stack disables authentication; credentialed backend acceptance is not implemented/verified.

phases.title: PostgreSQL and MongoDB Connectors
phases.findings: Neither backend has a connector implementation, dependency, schema mapping or query-translation test suite.

phases.title: Frontend-Neutral Search API
phases.findings: REST analyze, error contracts, IDs, health/version and typed SSE are UI-neutral. Public API still lacks a typed commerce filter/result contract and schema negotiation.

phases.title: Java SDK and historical Spring Boot Starter
phases.findings: Java SDK supports sync/async, retries and typed SSE; all modules target Java 25. Starter is intentionally removed and is not an outstanding requirement. Historical release notes are marked historical.

phases.title: JavaScript Web Component
phases.findings: TypeScript SDK is a client library. No customElements.define, browser widget, UI component contract or component tests.

phases.title: Developer Playground
phases.findings: Swagger/OpenAPI exists, but there is no playground displaying query, confidence, evidence and results. Earlier README and CI referenced absent playground files; those claims were removed.

phases.title: Search Analytics and Evaluation
phases.findings: Offline Precision@K, Recall@K, reciprocal rank/MRR and nDCG benchmark tooling exist. Operational metrics are not click/query analytics; production relevance judgments and quality acceptance remain separate.

phases.title: Plugin SDK Foundation
phases.findings: AI/search provider interfaces are extension points. No general plugin manifest, loading API, compatibility contract or third-party plugin SDK acceptance.

phases.title: Domain Pack Architecture
phases.findings: No domain-pack type, manifest, dependency boundary or domain-specific pack discovery.

phases.title: Connector Pack Architecture
phases.findings: No connector-pack manifest, configuration contract, install lifecycle or upgrade semantics. StructuredExecutionLimits comments labelled stages 33+ concern input budgets only.

phases.title: AI Provider Pack Architecture
phases.findings: AI provider registry/resolver and Ollama implementation exist. No provider-pack manifest, packaging, install lifecycle or second provider acceptance.

phases.title: Policy Pack Architecture
phases.findings: Threat-rule YAML files are not installable policy packs. No pack contract, scoped policy selection or lifecycle.

phases.title: Pack Registry and Lifecycle
phases.findings: Provider bean registries do not install/activate/disable/upgrade packs. No pack lifecycle state machine, rollback, signature or dependency management.

phases.title: Licensing and Entitlement Engine
phases.findings: Apache repository license exists. No runtime license validation, entitlement evaluation, signing keys or feature enforcement.

phases.title: Community, Professional and Enterprise Editions
phases.findings: No edition model, capability matrix or tested feature gates.

phases.title: QwenBridge Marketplace Foundation
phases.findings: No marketplace metadata contract, publisher validation, package publication workflow or marketplace API.

phases.title: Machine Output Parsing Foundation
phases.findings: AI search-JSON parsing exists for search analysis only. No machine-output parser SPI, canonical input formats or Kubernetes adapter.

phases.title: Typed Machine Event Model
phases.findings: PipelineEvent represents search lifecycle events, not a canonical machine event/source/resource schema.

phases.title: Machine-to-Human Explanation Engine
phases.findings: ThreatExplanation renders threat findings for one query. No general machine-event explanation service with retained evidence.

phases.title: Audience-Aware Explanation
phases.findings: No developer/DevOps/manager/end-user audience model, rendering policy or audience acceptance tests.

phases.title: Evidence and Source Attribution
phases.findings: Threat findings, grounded query spans and pipeline event timestamps provide local evidence. No machine-event evidence IDs, source/time attribution store or end-to-end citation contract.

phases.title: Root-Cause Analysis Engine
phases.findings: No ranked root-cause hypotheses, causal evidence model or root-cause evaluation dataset.

phases.title: Event Correlation Engine
phases.findings: Threat correlation combines rule findings from one input. It does not correlate machine events across services/resources/time.

phases.title: Timeline Reconstruction
phases.findings: Search pipeline events have order/timestamps. There is no machine-event timeline reconstruction or dependency/clock-skew handling.

phases.title: Impact and Blast-Radius Analysis
phases.findings: No service/resource dependency graph, impacted-user model, propagation analysis or uncertainty bounds.

phases.title: Recommended Action Engine
phases.findings: No action candidates, risk/success scoring or evidence-backed remediation ranking. Existing direct-answer executor contains placeholder output.

phases.title: Human Feedback and Correction Loop
phases.findings: No feedback endpoint/storage, correction lineage, reviewer identity or evaluation/correction loop.
